title: Mock Test

questions.question:
Identify the most appropriate synonym of the following word.
Sceptical
questions.solution:
C) Sceptical(adjective) – Doubtful, questioning, disbelieving, suspicious संदेहपूर्ण
Synonym:Incredulous(adjective) – Unwilling or unable to believe something, skeptical, doubtful. अविश्वासी

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Hypocrisy
questions.solution:
D)Hypocrisy(noun) – The practice of claiming to have moral standards or beliefs to which one's own behavior does not conform; pretense. पाखंड
Synonym:Deceit(noun) – The action or practice of deceiving someone by concealing or misrepresenting the truth; fraud, trickery. धोखा

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.
The sun was shining bright and intense in the sky.
questions.solution:
C) Intense(adjective) – Having or showing strong feelings, high degree of force or strength. तीव्र
Synonym:Strong(adjective) – Powerful, having a lot of force, intensity. मजबूत

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Attire
questions.solution:
D)Attire(noun) – Clothing, garments, apparel, dress. पोशाक
Synonym:Dress(noun) – Clothing, garments, attire, outfit. वस्त्र

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Bliss
questions.solution:
C) Bliss(noun) – Perfect happiness, great joy. आनंद
Synonym:Pleasure(noun) – A feeling of happy satisfaction and enjoyment. खुशी

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.
The documentary explored the historical and cultural significance of the ________ (antique) ruins in the region.
questions.solution:
A)Antique(adjective) – Belonging to ancient times; very old. प्राचीन
Synonym:Ancient(adjective) – Very old; of a long time ago, historic, archaic. प्राचीन

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Fasten
questions.solution:
A) Fasten(verb)– To attach or secure something in place, to close or join firmly. जोड़ना/ बांधना
Synonym: Bolt(verb)– To secure or lock in place, often by means of a bolt or similar device. पेंच कसना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Titanic
questions.solution:
C)Titanic(adjective) – Enormous, massive, colossal, gigantic. विशाल
Synonym:Huge(adjective) – Extremely large, vast, immense. बहुत बड़ा

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.
Mr. Satterthwaite was shrewd enough to penetrate her meaning.
questions.solution:
D) Shrewd(adjective) – Having or showing sharp powers of judgment; astute, clever, perceptive. चतुर
Synonym:Smart(adjective) – Intelligent, astute, clever, bright, perceptive. होशियार

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in brackets to fill in the blank.
Queen Gulnaar of Arabia mourned her ________ beauty. (waning)
questions.solution:
C)Waning(adjective) – Decreasing in size, amount, length, or quality; diminishing, declining. घटती हुई
Synonym:Fading(adjective) – Losing brightness, strength, or vitality; diminishing, declining. मुरझाना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.
The meeting was brought to a ________ (rapid) conclusion.
questions.solution:
B) Rapid (adjective)– Moving or acting with great speed, quick, fast. तेज
Synonym: Hasty (adjective)– Done or acting with excessive speed or urgency, hurried, rushed. शीघ्र

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.
The girl tried to alleviate her brother’s problem
questions.solution:
C) Alleviate(verb) – To make something less severe, to relieve, to ease. कम करना
Synonym: Reduce(verb) – To make something smaller or less in amount, degree, or size, to lessen. कम करना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.
John is very generous; he regularly gives alms to the poor
questions.solution:
A) Generous(adjective) – Willing to give more of something, such as money or time, than is strictly necessary or expected; liberal, charitable. उदार
Synonym: Kind(adjective) – Having or showing a friendly, generous, and considerate nature; compassionate, benevolent. दयालु

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Luminous
questions.solution:
C) Luminous(adjective) – Emitting or reflecting light, shining, glowing. प्रकाशमान, चमकदार
Synonym:Radiant(adjective) – Sending out light, shining, bright, glowing. तेजस्वी

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Rectify
questions.solution:
C)Rectify(verb) – Correct, put right, amend, remedy. सुधारना
Synonym:Correct(verb) – To make right, fix, repair, amend. ठीक करना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Alert
questions.solution:
A)Alert(adjective) – Watchful, quick to notice any unusual and potentially dangerous or difficult circumstances. सतर्क
Synonym:Vigilant(adjective) – Keeping careful watch for possible danger or difficulties. चौकस

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Retract
questions.solution:
B)Retract(verb) – To draw back or withdraw, revoke, take back. वापस लेना/ मुकर जाना
Synonym:Revoke(verb) – To take back or withdraw, cancel, rescind. रद्द करना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.
For Rana, unable to see a thing, the parade seemed to last forever.
questions.solution:
C) Parade(noun) – a public procession, especially one celebrating a special day or event. जलूस
Synonym:Procession(noun) – A number of people or vehicles moving forward in an orderly fashion, especially as part of a ceremony. जलूस

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.
The removal of petty restrictions has made life easier.
questions.solution:
D) Petty(adjective) – of little importance, trivial, minor, insignificant. तुच्छ
Synonym:Small(adjective) – of a size that is less than normal or usual, insignificant, minor. छोटा

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Estimate
questions.solution:
D) Estimate (verb)– To judge or calculate the value, number, quantity, or extent of something. अनुमान लगाना
Synonym: Evaluate (verb)– To assess or determine the value, significance, or extent of something. मूल्यांकन करना
